daily_recurrence.Description: For a schedule that runs daily at a specified time.

database.Description: The Firestore database id. Defaults to '"(default)"'.

name.Description:
The unique backup schedule identifier across all locations and databases for the given project. Format:
'projects/{{project}}/databases/{{database}}/backupSchedules/{{backupSchedule}}'

retention.Description:
At what relative time in the future, compared to its creation time, the backup should be deleted, e.g. keep backups for 7 days.
A duration in seconds with up to nine fractional digits, ending with 's'. Example: "3.5s".

For a daily backup recurrence, set this to a value up to 7 days. If you set a weekly backup recurrence, set this to a value up to 14 weeks.

weekly_recurrence.Description: For a schedule that runs weekly on a specific day and time.

day.Description: The day of week to run. Possible values: ["DAY_OF_WEEK_UNSPECIFIED", "MONDAY", "TUESDAY", "WEDNESDAY", "THURSDAY", "FRIDAY", "SATURDAY", "SUNDAY"]
